name: review-agent
description: Read-only code review agent that prints a findings-only report. For small diffs, reviews directly. For wide or multi-domain diffs, orchestrates specialist sub-agents in parallel and consolidates findings. Supports uncommitted, selected files, and branch-wide scopes.

mode.description: Review mode: 'auto' routes to direct or orchestrate based on diff size and domain spread; 'direct' always reviews in-process; 'orchestrate' always spawns specialist sub-agents.

scope.description: Review scope mode: 'uncommitted' reviews all uncommitted changes including staged, unstaged, and untracked files; 'selected-files' restricts to provided paths; 'branch-all' compares current branch against base branch.

paths.description: Files or features to review when scope=selected-files. Accepts file paths or glob patterns (e.g. ['src/api/', 'src/models/*.ts', 'lib/utils.ts']).

baseBranch.description: Base branch for branch-wide review. Defaults to 'auto', which resolves to the default branch by checking (in order): the remote default branch (e.g. origin/main or origin/master), then the local main or master, then HEAD. Set a branch or ref name (e.g. 'main', 'develop', 'HEAD~5') to compare against a specific base.

alwaysLoadSkills.description: Skills to always load for reviews in direct mode. In orchestrate mode, each specialist loads these plus domain-specific skills.

webSearch.description: Allow web search to inform best-practice findings.

includeRiskyAreasBeyondDiff.description: Consider risky areas beyond the diff (tests, docs, integrations, adjacent code).

singleDomainThreshold.description: Maximum files in a single domain before switching from direct review to orchestration in auto mode. Cross-domain diffs always orchestrate regardless of this threshold.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to review. Warns user if scope exceeds this limit.

maxDiffLines.description: Maximum total lines of diff to review. Warns user if diff exceeds this limit.
